newsitem.title: USA: Bolivia selling reconstituted crude for mid-April.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia selling reconstituted crude for mid-April.

text.p: Bolivia's state-owned oil company is selling 260,000 barrels of reconstituted crude available for loading April 15, trade sources said on Monday.
Yacimientos Petroliferos Fiscales Bolivianos (YPFB) will receive bids on April 11.
Bolivia's reconstituted crude contains about 45 percent gasoline and has an API gravity of around 45 degrees.
The crude loads at the Chilean port of Arica.
Bolivia holds tenders for reconstituted crude about every two months.
